offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures business jets, turboprops, helicopters, military and special mission aircraft, and unmanned systems. Also makes golf cars, utility vehicles, powered tools, and industrial components. Sells to businesses, consumers, and governments, and provides aftermarket parts and service.

primary_products.value: business jets; turboprop aircraft; helicopters; golf cars and off-road vehicles; piston aircraft and avionics

primary_services.value: aircraft maintenance and repair; aftermarket parts support; pilot training; customer financing

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporations, charter and fleet operators, golf courses, industrial and utility users; B2C: individual aircraft owners, golf car and recreational vehicle buyers; B2G: US and foreign militaries and government agencies

end_markets.value: business aviation; defense; golf and recreation; industrial and utility equipment; commercial aviation

revenue_model.value: product sales: new aircraft, helicopters, vehicles, tools and components; service fees: aircraft maintenance, parts, and support; project or contract: military helicopter and defense programs; interest or premiums: financing of customer purchases
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds aircraft, vehicles and tools from purchased and in-house components, sold to operators, dealers and governments; service provider: maintenance and service centers for aircraft and aftermarket support

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: aviation, Bell helicopters, industrial vehicles and tools, systems, and finance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: aircraft sold to corporations, governments, and fleet customers; distributors / dealers: golf car, utility vehicle and tool dealers and distributors; own locations: company-owned service centers for aircraft
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aircraft need FAA and foreign aviation certification, defense work subject to export controls and government contract rules
